title: Pricing & Billing Request Routing and Evaluation Criteria (Outcome Mapping)
creator: Asha Menon
description: Define a compact, unambiguous routing and evaluation criteria set for non-bug customer requests related to pricing, commitments, invoicing, cost allocation and marketplace fees. The doc will prescribe: 1) an intake form pattern for Sales/CS to submit requests, 2) deterministic routing rules (self-serve, PM review, sales ops, legal/finance), 3) a triage rubric to score requests (financial delta, contractual risk, implementation effort, recurrence), and 4) outcome mapping (quick win, policy change, product change, contract-level exception). Goal: reduce latency to decision, provide consistent outcomes, and create telemetry for prioritization and roadmap signals.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Intake form prototype available and integrated as a templated sheet linked from Sales/CS playbook
A2: Routing rules documented with ownership and SLAs for each path: self-serve (24h), PM review (5 business days), contract exception (10 business days)
A3: Triage rubric implemented as a scoring spreadsheet and a lightweight automation that assigns a preliminary score upon submission
A4: Outcome mapping defined and examples documented (5 canonical examples covering commitments, invoices, marketplace pricing, and cost allocation)
A5: Dashboard wireframe that surfaces volume by category, average decision time, and dollar impact available for review by Finance and GTM
decision_log: 2026-03-06: Agreed to prioritize deterministic routing over ad-hoc PM judgment to reduce decision variance — attendees: Asha, Diego, Priya (Sales Ops)
2026-03-08: Scoring rubric will weight recurring revenue impact (40%), contract/legal risk (25%), engineering effort (20%), and customer strategic value (15%) — validated with Finance
2026-03-09: For marketplace pricing asks, route first to Marketplace Ops for quick policy checks before PM review to avoid unnecessary product changes
discussion: Trade-offs: High automation reduces human context but speeds decisions; we will pilot with a 5-business-day human override window.
Engineering effort estimate includes small Airtable/Zendesk integration and a dashboard tile in Console — ENG involvement required (see dependencies).
Compliance: invoicing changes require Finance + Legal sign-off; those flows will be explicitly call-out in the routing table.
Edge-cases: legacy commitments and marketplace credits need a separate escalation path to Solutions Eng for migration planning.
follow_up_tasks: Create intake form template and embed in Sales/CS handbook (owner: Diego)
Prototype scoring spreadsheet and sample auto-score formulas (owner: Asha)
Build a lightweight Zapier/Airtable integration to post new requests to a triage Slack channel (owner: Sales Ops)
Ship dashboard wireframe to Finance and PM leads for feedback (owner: Product Analytics)
Draft standard response templates and contract exception playbook for Legal (owner: Legal)
comments: 2026-03-06 - Priya (Sales Ops): There are frequently asks that are low engineering effort but high finance impact; the rubric should catch both dimensions.
2026-03-07 - Marco (Finance): Need to ensure every invoicing change has a clear rollback and accounting owner before approval is given.
2026-03-09 - Leila (Marketplace Ops): We'll run a 2-week pilot to validate routing time and false positives for policy-level marketplace changes.
2026-03-10 - Diego: Draft intake form posted to the drive for initial feedback (link above).
